captions.detailed: This 3D model represents a portable site-security tripod mast. It consists of a central cylindrical hub in black, from which three thin, grey cylindrical folding legs extend downwards to the ground. A long, grey telescoping vertical post extends upwards from the hub and is topped by a black camera unit. The legs fold relative to the base hub, the central post extends prismatically, and the camera unit rotates continuously on its pan bearing while tilting on its revolute joint.
captions.instruction: Create a 3D model of a portable site-security tripod mast. It should feature three folding grey legs attached to a central black hub, a vertical telescoping central post, and a black security camera mounted at the top that can pan and tilt.
captions.factory: Construct the base hub using a central cylinder with three small rectangular hinge brackets offset radially. Model the legs as long cylinders with spherical rubber tips, rotated and translated into their tripod stance. Create the telescoping post using a nested cylinder extending vertically from the hub. Finally, build the camera assembly at the top of the post using a combination of a panning cylinder joint, a mounting yoke, and a box-shaped camera body with a cylindrical lens.
